title: SwiftDrop event envelope
description: Shared wrapper for every event published on RabbitMQ. Each event schema narrows eventType and data.

eventId.description: Unique per event. Also sent as the AMQP message_id. Consumers use it to skip duplicates.

eventType.description: <entity>.<past-tense-verb>, the same value as the routing key

version.description: Schema version of data. Raised only for breaking changes.

occurredAt.description: When the change happened (UTC), not when the message was sent

producer.description: Name of the publishing service, for example identity-merchant-service
